[*]Five puzzles
[*]Two new tracks
[*]Share through Steam Workshop
[*]Subscribe through Steam Workshop

Based on Epic Unreal Engine 5.4.4

notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content:
We are busy working on the next update.

So far we have successfully tested Achievements and Leaderboards. Publishing and subscribing Workshop Items is the next test. This will allow you to share your creations and enjoy the creativity of others. 

As always, we love to hear what you have to say: join us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2931520/discussions/]discussions[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/channels/1159624932939026542/1246516838939234344]discord[/url]

notes.title: New marble dynamics in funnels
notes.content:
[list]
Marbles in funnels now use Lagrangian mechanics instead of Epic's Unreal physics.
Vive menu items are moved to proper place.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Loop Boost setting is honored; trying to get achievements/Leaderboard working; fix for background music randomly stopping. We are working hard to insure funnels and blocks work properly (that is, replace Unreal physics with something more robust for these pieces).

Please join the discussion to influence our priorities.
